test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Identify the correctly matched pairs.

1. Kalibangan - Fire altars

2. Megasthenes - Arthashastra

3. Chalcolithic culture - Use of both copper and stone
solution:
The correct answer is __**1 and 3 only**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Kalibangan - Fire altars:**

 
 
• Kalibangan is an important site of the **Indus Valley Civilization**, located in present-day Rajasthan, India.
 
• The site is well-known for the discovery of **fire altars**, which were used for ritualistic purposes. These altars signify the practice of fire worship in the Harappan culture.
 
• The discovery of fire altars at Kalibangan is unique and highlights the religious or ritualistic practices of the Harappan people. *Hence, this statement is correct.*
 
 
 
• **Megasthenes - Arthashastra:**
 
 
• **Megasthenes** was a Greek ambassador in the court of Mauryan emperor Chandragupta Maurya. He authored the book **Indica**, which provides a detailed account of Mauryan India.
